existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: R6 Practitioner has one hard local instance-format break: `Practitioner.communication` changed from `CodeableConcept[]` to a backbone array. The main migration concerns are communication reshaping/semantics, required BCP 47 language validation, and new modifier/status handling for `active`, `deceased[x]`, and qualification status. The top uncertainty is terminology and official rationale because no live expansions or official diff were used.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migrations should treat Practitioner communication as a special case rather than a simple same-path copy. R4 language CodeableConcepts must be wrapped into `communication.language`, checked against the R6 required all-languages binding, and reviewed for whether they belong on Practitioner or PractitionerRole. Runtime stacks must regenerate models and honor R6 modifier semantics for `active` and `deceased[x]`. Downgrade paths need extensions or documented loss for `deceased[x]`, `communication.preferred`, and `qualification.status`.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural, cardinality, datatype, reference target, and flag findings because they come directly from local R4 and R6 StructureDefinitions and package indexes. Confidence is medium for terminology prevalence and justification because no live terminology expansion, official diff, Jira item, or narrative page was consulted.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
Practitioner keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 1 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 1 potential hard break(s), 2 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 2 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 3, which creates meaningful stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 32/100, producing migration shape `mostly-stable-with-local-breaks`, major migration `No`, and compatibility posture `preserve-compatibility-per-change`.

3 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Treat this as a mostly stable resource. Individual hard breaks, renames, required bindings, or behavior changes should stand or fall on their own rationale and available less-breaking alternatives.

topFindings.title: Practitioner.communication changed from CodeableConcept to a BackboneElement with language and preferred children
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances with `coding` or `text` directly under each `communication[]` item do not match the R6 BackboneElement shape; runtime/API/codegen also changes from a simple `CodeableConcept` array to a component array.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Practitioner communication language binding strengthened from preferred languages to required all-languages
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: a migrated text-only or local-code `CodeableConcept` that satisfied an R4 preferred binding may fail the R6 required all-languages binding unless it includes a valid BCP 47 coding.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: semantic/documentation: instances may validate after migration, but values formerly meaning patient-facing language capability may need relocation to `PractitionerRole.communication`; R6 data read by R4 systems may also be interpreted with the old patient-communication meaning.
